consumer: avatar_action::move's friendly-NPC interaction handler, which raises an interactive query (swap places / talk / attack / push) answered through the real active input loop when the destination tile holds a friendly NPC
scope: the single interactive npc-interaction prompt for the friendly NPC on the destination tile, answered through the engine's real active input loop
decisive_source: src/handle_action.cpp::game::handle_action (ACTION_MOVE_*) which only calls avatar_action::move and reads a moved bool; the authoritative behavior lives inside avatar_action::move where the friendly-NPC branch issues the interactive swap/displace query
divergence: avatar steps into a tile occupied by a friendly NPC: the engine fires the swap/talk/attack prompt and the outcome depends on the answer, but the proposed surface only reports moved=true/false and silently defaults the prompt, so a swap-vs-no-swap divergence is invisible
